situation: The longest slice brief in the repo, 3,670 words, reconciled against its commits. Eighteen-fold compression before the commits are folded in at all.
expected_guard: the output is at or under 200 words despite an input of 3,670 plus its commits
must_not: cut what landed in order to fit the brief's own content — the landed view is the deliverable and the brief is the input
summarise the brief and stop, which is what happens when the input dominates the budget
why_this_fixture_exists: The card demands a fixture on input large enough to strain the ceiling, and the stage mode has one. The slice mode had none — a scale gap the driver could not see, because no slice fixture recorded a word count. This is that rule applied at the second scale, and the brief is the real longest in the repo rather than a convenient one.
